def spiral_order(matrix):
    if not matrix: return []
    R, C = len(matrix), len(matrix[0])
    visited = [[False]*C for _ in range(R)]
    ans = []
    dr = [0, 1, 0, -1]
    dc = [1, 0, -1, 0]
    r = c = di = 0
    for i in range(4):
        while 0 <= r < R and 0 <= c < C and not visited[r][c]:
            ans.append(matrix[r][c])
            visited[r][c] = True
            r += dr[di]
            c += dc[di]
        r -= dr[di-1]
        c -= dc[di-1]
        di = (di + 1) % 4
    return ans
